archetypes.name: Turbo Tree Baron
archetypes.philosophy: Reduce bullet reserve to 100 and increase tree planting probability to 60%, establishing a massive economy within the first 300 rounds to fund rapid unit production or VP accumulation.
key_changes: Reduce BULLET_RESERVE from 300 to 100
Increase tree planting probability from 0.25 to 0.60
Increase gardener hire probability from 0.01 to 0.03
Add tree-watering logic to maintain tree health and income

archetypes.name: Soldier Swarm v2
archetypes.philosophy: Increase soldier production from 1% to 10% per gardener per turn, and have soldiers use triad shots for superior firepower to overwhelm opponents with sheer ranged volume.
key_changes: Increase soldier build probability from 0.01 to 0.10
Add triad shot firing logic for soldiers
Have soldiers converge toward archon broadcast location for grouping
Reduce tree planting to 10% to prioritize unit production

archetypes.name: Rapid VP Harvester
archetypes.philosophy: Lower the bullet reserve to 50 and donate every excess bullet immediately, while building only minimal military (one gardener, occasional soldier) to hit 1000 VP before round 1500.
key_changes: Reduce BULLET_RESERVE from 300 to 50
Remove donate threshold — donate all excess bullets each turn
Limit gardener count to 1, tree count to 2
Build one soldier every 50 rounds for minimal defense
archetypes.engagement_style: Pure economic focus with minimal defense

archetypes.name: Aggressive Gardener
archetypes.philosophy: Hire gardeners at 5% chance instead of 1%, and have each gardener build soldiers at 8% chance while maintaining moderate tree economy for sustained production.
key_changes: Increase gardener hire probability from 0.01 to 0.05
Increase soldier build probability from 0.01 to 0.08
Increase tree planting to 40% for economy backbone
Have gardeners move toward nearest friendly archon for protection
archetypes.engagement_style: Balanced economy with fast military ramp

archetypes.name: Specialized Economy
archetypes.philosophy: Use broadcast channels to designate gardeners as either 'planter' (80% tree planting, no building) or 'builder' (80% building, no planting) for efficient resource allocation.
key_changes: Add broadcast-based gardener role assignment using channels 10-11
Planter gardeners: 80% plant tree, 5% build soldier
Builder gardeners: 5% plant tree, 30% build soldier
Archon alternates hiring planter and builder gardeners

archetypes.name: Lumberjack Tree Raider
archetypes.philosophy: Prioritize lumberjacks (30% build chance) to chop neutral trees for free bullet income and early robot spawns, then swarm enemies with melee pressure.
key_changes: Increase lumberjack build probability to 0.30
Add neutral tree chopping logic before enemy chasing
Have lumberjacks shake trees for contained bullets
Reduce soldier builds to 2% — rely on lumberjacks for early combat
archetypes.engagement_style: Aggressive melee disruption with tree income

archetypes.name: Combat Micro Soldiers
archetypes.philosophy: Keep standard production rates but add bullet-dodging, pentad shots when enemies are clustered, and tactical retreat when low on health to dramatically improve soldier survivability and kill efficiency.
key_changes: Add willCollideWithMe-based dodge movement for soldiers
Add pentad shot when 3+ enemies in sensor range
Add retreat logic when soldier HP drops below 50%
Have soldiers move toward nearest enemy instead of randomly

archetypes.name: Fast Start Archon
archetypes.philosophy: Focus the first 100 rounds on rapid gardener hiring (15% chance) and tree planting (50%) to establish economy momentum, then transition to 10% soldier builds for military.
key_changes: First 100 rounds: gardener hire at 15%, tree plant at 50%
After round 100: gardener hire drops to 1%, soldier builds increase to 10%
Archon moves toward map center early for positioning
Donate only after round 200 to avoid starving early economy

archetypes.name: Tank Commander
archetypes.philosophy: Rush Tanks as the primary combat unit — their 200 HP and 5 attack power dominate the battlefield. Use triad shots and tree body-ramming to crush through defenses.
key_changes: Add Tank building in BulletSpending (30% chance when possible)
Create Tank.java with triad shot combat and tree ramming
Keep 2 gardeners producing tanks exclusively
Add tank group movement toward nearest enemy location

archetypes.name: Scout Harassment Fleet
archetypes.philosophy: Build cheap Scouts (80 bullets) to harass enemies, collect bullets from across the map via tree shaking, and funnel all surplus into VP donations while scouts keep the enemy distracted.
key_changes: Create Scout.java with harassment, bullet collection, and tree shaking
Build scouts at 25% chance — they're cheap and fast
Scouts shake every tree they pass for free bullets
All excess bullets donated to VP; scouts provide map control

archetypes.name: Lumberjack Horde
archetypes.philosophy: Flood the map with lumberjacks (60% build rate) — they're cheap melee units that can chop trees for income, strike in area-of-effect, and overwhelm opponents who can't handle close-range pressure.
key_changes: Set lumberjack build probability to 60%
Stop building soldiers entirely
Lumberjacks prioritize chopping neutral trees then striking enemies
Use lumberjack AOE strike as primary damage source
archetypes.engagement_style: Massive melee swarm with AOE strikes

archetypes.name: VP Blitz Donator
archetypes.philosophy: Abandon all military production and tree economy. Hire exactly one gardener, build zero units, plant zero trees, and donate every single bullet above 0 to rush 1000 VP as fast as mathematically possible.
key_changes: Remove all building and planting logic
Hire one gardener then stop hiring
BULLET_RESERVE set to 0 — donate all bullets every turn
Gardener does nothing but exist; archon moves to safety
archetypes.engagement_style: Pure VP rush with zero military

archetypes.name: Multi-Vector Strike
archetypes.philosophy: Use broadcast channels to split forces into two groups that attack from different angles simultaneously, preventing the enemy from defending one chokepoint and creating crossfire opportunities.
key_changes: Archon assigns units to group A or B using broadcast channel 20
Groups move to opposite sides of the enemy archon location
Soldiers use triad shots for area denial
Add group-based movement logic instead of random wandering

archetypes.name: Military Gardener Factory
archetypes.philosophy: Gardeners never plant trees — instead they focus 100% on building soldiers (40% build chance) and tanks (15% build chance) to maximize military output from day one.
key_changes: Remove all tree planting from gardeners
Increase soldier build to 40% and add tank builds at 15%
Archon hires gardeners at 8% chance for rapid factory setup
BULLET_RESERVE stays at 200 for sustained production

archetypes.name: Ambush Predator
archetypes.philosophy: Build a moderate military (soldiers and lumberjacks) but have them hold position near the archon instead of roaming. Let enemies come to you, then counter-attack with superior positioning and triad/pentad shots.
key_changes: Units stay within sensor radius of nearest archon broadcast location
Soldiers use pentad shots when enemies are within range 5
Lumberjacks only move to strike when enemies enter their range
Counter-attack: once enemy retreats, pursue with full force

archetypes.name: Mixed Arms Doctrine
archetypes.philosophy: Build all unit types in balanced proportions — scouts for vision and harassment, soldiers for ranged DPS, tanks for frontline durability, and lumberjacks for tree income and melee — creating a combined-arms force with no single counter.
key_changes: Create Scout.java and Tank.java for full unit roster
Gardener builds: 20% soldier, 10% tank, 10% scout, 10% lumberjack
Scouts scout ahead and report enemy locations via broadcast
Tanks tank damage while soldiers and lumberjacks deal damage
